title.narrative: Improving the integration and empowerment of individuals with disabilities to promote more inclusive and equitable opportunities

description.narrative: ltpgtEnvelope 3: Breaking down Barriers/Disability Inclusionltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtStreet Child Nigeria, in consortium with three national Organizations of People with Disabilities-Cedar Foundation for Disability (CFfD), Adamawa People Living with Disabilities Initiative (APLWDI) and Care Aid Support Initiative (CASI) proposes a project to enhance inclusion and empowerment of People Living with Disabilities (PLWD) across six LGAs - Bama and MMC In Bornu State, Geidam and Gujba in Yobe State and Mubi North and Gombi LGAs in Adamawa State, NE Nigeria.ltbrgtWith this project we will be working to:ltbrgtEnsure Access to Preventive and Comprehensive Services for Persons Living with Disability: The project focuses on providing access to preventive and responsive services for women, girls, and children with disabilities who are at risk of abuse, discrimination, exploitation, neglect, and violence. This will encompass creating a support system tailored to the specific needs of Persons Living with Disability.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtStrengthen Community Support Networks: Emphasizing the eradication of violence, abuse, and harmful traditional practices targeting persons with disabilities, this project seeks to bolster community support networks. This includes promoting awareness and education to eliminate harmful practices, mindsets and stereotypes.ltbrgtEnhance Stakeholder Capacities: The project aims to enhance the capabilities and capacities of relevant stakeholders and actors at both state and local levels. By fostering knowledge and understanding, the initiative seeks to promote, adopt, and sustain actions and legislations that foster disability inclusion.ltbrgtThrough collaborative efforts and a multi-faceted approach, this project aims to create a more inclusive and supportive environment for People Living with Disabilities in the targeted LGAs, ultimately contributing to their empowerment, protection, and full participation in the society.ltbrgtlt/pgt
